scope: M1 runtime HUD and world-space enemy health presentation

information_hierarchy: top-left: player portrait, life value/bar, dash readiness/bar
top-center: enemy-friendly-fire objective and soul/exit instruction
top-right: room number, soul count, exit lock/open state
bottom-center: Haste and Giant cards, keys, effects, availability and selection state
bottom hint: selection, dash, restart and cancel controls

color_and_shape.giant: orange frame plus hexagonal mass icon
color_and_shape.health: mint line/bar, red at or below 34 percent
color_and_shape.panels: opaque navy panels with blue-gray outlines

runtime_contract.player_health: live numeric value and proportional fill
runtime_contract.dash: READY state or cooldown seconds with proportional refill
runtime_contract.blessing_slots: READY, SELECTED, or BOUND from actual slot ownership
runtime_contract.souls_and_exit: live room lifecycle state against the required 3 souls

provenance_note: The HUD panels, bars, layout, text and line material are deterministic Unity UI construction, not new AI-generated images. Existing recorded M1 production icons are reused.
scope_note: No Echo slot, M2 room UI, inventory, minimap, meta progression, marketing UI or mobile controls were added.
